answer: Sequential Work Ledger: each new identity must complete N verified micro-tasks whose outputs depend on prior ledger state, so identities can't be mass-produced in parallel. Registration requires solving a challenge derived from the current ledger head, like carving a ledge only reachable after the prior climb. Attacker cost: N sequential compute-hours per identity, non-parallelizable, plus a glacier of accumulated history to fake. Honest agents build standing like a garden over time; fresh sybils start barren.
